name: Honda CB500 Four
engine: 498 cc air-cooled SOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: Honda's first middleweight four. Smooth and well built, with a few electrical weak spots to sort.

add.title: Replace the fuse box if it's tired
add.instructions: Check the original fuse box for heat damage, melted plastic and loose clips. Replace it if there's any doubt.
add.reason: The fuse box is a common failure point on these bikes, and it's easy to replace.

F: Test the charging system before buying parts. Stators can be expensive, so confirm it's the stator first.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Fuse box meltdown
known.what: The original fuse box can overheat and fail.
